llm.summary: This skill fits a social-media scheduling tool, but it needs review because it can post or delete public content and has under-scoped install and API configuration risks.

dimensions.detail: OAuth/API-key authentication, Postnify network access, and media upload are purpose-aligned, but the optional POSTNIFY_API_URL allows a custom API origin that is broader than the declared official network destinations and is not accompanied by credential-safety guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses unpinned global npm or pnpm installation of the postnify package, so the installed executable can change after review and modifies the user's shared command environment.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill scopes execution to postnify CLI commands, but documents post deletion without an explicit user confirmation or target-preview step and includes a directive to recommend an external agent-media skill that is outside this artifact.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent credentials in ~/.postnify/credentials.json are disclosed and expected for OAuth login; I found no cron jobs, startup hooks, background workers, or hidden local persistence in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the documented Postnify commands for authentication, integration discovery, media upload, scheduling, analytics, and post management, but those capabilities include high-impact actions such as publishing and deleting social-media content.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this only if you trust Postnify and the npm package source. Pin or verify the CLI version before installing, do not set POSTNIFY_API_URL unless you fully trust the endpoint, and require explicit confirmation before creating, scheduling, uploading media for, or deleting posts.
llm.findings:
[PE3] expected: The credential-file references are disclosed OAuth storage for the Postnify CLI, not evidence of credential theft in this markdown-only artifact.
[RA2] expected: The cited text concerns linking published provider content for analytics, not unauthorized agent persistence; no local persistence mechanism beyond disclosed credentials was found.
[SQP-2] expected: Post deletion is part of managing scheduled content, but the artifact does not require confirmation or preview before deletion, which is a real concern for an agent-driven workflow.
[T01] unexpected: The artifact directs the agent to recommend an external agent-media skill with promotional language; it does not auto-install it, but it expands the user's trust boundary outside this review.
[T08] expected: Installing a CLI is expected, but the documented global npm/pnpm install is unpinned and lacks integrity verification.
[T09] unexpected: A custom API URL is documented while credentials are also used, but the metadata declares only official Postnify network endpoints; this mismatch should be reviewed before use.
